work_completed: Added packages/toi/src/extract.ts: extractToi(input, options) + ExtractOptions, deterministic regex/phrase NL->.toi extraction over SPEC §7 fields (identity, cognitive_profile, privacy, agency, communication, ethical_pillars). Confident-only matching; lossless via custom.freeform_terms and custom.x-extract.matched_fields; output guaranteed schema-valid through safeParseToi.
Exported extractToi and ExtractOptions from packages/toi/src/index.ts (semver-covered surface).

Added packages/toi/test/extract.test.ts: 26 tests covering rich declarations, ambiguous text (anonymous/no sections), confident-only guards, clause-boundary name capture, freeform/x-extract preservation, boolean gating, options/metadata, enum field mapping, tier validity.
Aligned extraction rules to templates/personal-toi-template.md vocabulary and added a filled-out-template integration test.

Review-fix commit (2074df1) per nlt-code-reviewer: closed the two Important false positives (call-me clause over-capture, bare 'shared' -> override_authority) and six Minor items (spoon qualifier, permanent context, bare 'direct', bare 'permitted', negation-aware boolean gates via positive(), self_described case/terminator). 8 regression tests added (34 extract tests / 99 total).

Fixed latent bugs: extractAuthor captured only pattern #1 (call-me never matched) and risked adjective-as-name; fallbackAuthor could emit empty author; rule gaps for natural phrasings (energy is steady, opt-in analytics, honor deletion immediately, full-context hyphen, context-sensitive, brief collision with attention option).
Typecheck, vitest (99 tests green), and tsc build all pass. Feature branch pushed, PR #28 opened. nlt-code-reviewer verdict: APPROVE_WITH_NITS (no blocking items).
decisions_made: TypeScript-only scope (Rust/Go/Python ports untouched) per user approval.
Confident-only extraction: weak/unmatched text never populates a field; absence = no stated preference (SPEC §7).
Handle stored bare (no '@'); boolean fields set only on positive pattern match.
Bare 'brief'/'direct' tightened to verb forms to avoid cross-field leakage (e.g. 'Short Bursts (brief, focused interactions)').
Filled-out-template test uses the user's selected options (unchecked options omitted) to keep extraction deterministic.
